hero.lead: Outward, we are an international digital bank serving users around the world. Inward, we are an open-source exemplar growing on the ASDM system — built for real production from the very first line of code.

identity.label: Dual Identity
identity.lead: ABNK answers two questions at once: how should a bank serve the world, and how should an enterprise embrace AI? We chose one system to deliver both answers.

items.title: A Bank
items.body: An international digital bank for users around the world. Starting from the Chinese market, with long-termism as our method, we bring the steadiness, clarity and trust a bank owes to everyone.

items.title: A Blueprint
items.body: A living sample and real application growing on the ASDM system. Its goal is not to demo, but to run in real production; its process, code and design are fully open for any enterprise that wants to reshape itself with AI.

globalPath.label: Global Path
globalPath.lead: ABNK was born global. We expand with a clear and patient rhythm — every step is built on a verified foundation.

stages.name: China
stages.body: First landing in the most digitally dynamic market — honing the system, proving the paradigm.

stages.name: Southeast Asia
stages.body: Reaching neighboring markets of many cultures and languages, testing how well the system adapts.

stages.name: Belt & Road
stages.body: Extending along the corridors that connect the world, letting one method grow across a wider map.

stages.name: Developed Markets
stages.body: Standing the same test in the most mature and demanding markets.

asdm.label: Built on ASDM
asdm.lead: ASDM is an AI-first system development methodology and platform. ABNK does not bolt AI onto an existing process — from day one, AI is how the system is born and how it grows.

phases.name: Discover
phases.body: AI and the team work together to map intent and constraints, settling vague ideas into structured knowledge.

phases.name: Design
phases.body: Experience, architecture and standards are generated, reasoned and validated within one shared knowledge graph.

phases.name: Build
phases.body: AI takes part in producing and reviewing every line of code, while people stay accountable for the key judgments.

phases.name: Operate
phases.body: Delivery is not the end. The system keeps learning, iterating and evolving in real operation.

openSource.label: Open by Default
openSource.lead: For enterprises pursuing end-to-end digital transformation with AI, what is scarcest is not tools — it is a real, complete, verifiable precedent. ABNK chooses to be that precedent.

assets.name: Process
assets.body: Every step from intent to launch — every decision, every retrospective — openly recorded in a traceable way.

assets.name: Code
assets.body: Complete code written to real production standards, open for anyone to read, examine and borrow from.

assets.name: Design
assets.body: Design language, interaction standards and experience decisions are opened in sync — making good experience reproducible.

quote.line2: are not at odds — they were always meant to come from the same attitude.

items.name: Steadfast
items.body: A bank's first duty is to be trusted. We make every decision for the long term, and never chase the noise.

items.name: Precise
items.body: We treat every detail with engineering rigor — measurable, verifiable, traceable.

items.name: Open
items.body: We put our process and outcomes to public scrutiny. Transparency is the best guarantee of quality.

items.name: Caring
items.body: Technology ends with people. Everyone deserves to be treated with care and as an equal.

title.line1: This is the beginning of a bank,
title.line2: and the proof of a method.

closing.lead: Whether you care about a trustworthy new bank, or about how AI can truly change an enterprise — you are welcome to witness it with us.
